Description

A rampaging blue wolf-like monster with four horns jutting from its back. It sometimes breathes fire. - Imban

Defense

AC 24, touch 12, flat-footed 21 (+3 Dex, +12 natural, -1 size)

hp 184 [256] (16d10+96)

Fort +15, Ref +15, Will +8

Absorb fire

Offense

Speed 30 ft.

Melee 2 claws +23 (1d6+8), gore +24 (2d6+8)

Space 10 ft.; Reach 5 ft.

Special Attacks Berserk Pounce, Fire Breath (20-ft. cone, 10d6 fire damage, Reflex DC 23 for half, usable every 1d4 rounds), Greater Berserk, Impale

Statistics

Str 26, Dex 16, Con 20, Int 6, Wis 12, Cha 8

Base Atk +16; CMB +25 (+27 overrun); CMD 38 (40 vs. overrun, 42 vs. trip)

Feats Charge Through, Improved Natural Attack (Gore), Improved Overrun, Iron Will, Lightning Reflexes, Power Attack, Toughness, Weapon Focus (Gore)

Skills Perception +20

Ecology

Environment plains

Organization small group (1-3)

Treasure incidental

description.value: A berserk balivarha can make a full attack at the end of its charge.

A balivarha that takes damage in combat goes berserk on its next turn, attacking madly until either it or its opponent is dead. It gains a +3 bonus on melee attack rolls, melee damage rolls, and Will saving throws but takes a -2 penalty to its Armor Class. It also gains 3 temporary hit points per Hit Die, which is 48 temporary hit points for most balivarhas. In addition, the balivarha gains immunity to fear and the pounce ability. The balivarha cannot end its berserk state voluntarily.

effect: Gain rolled temporary HP once on entering berserk.

description.value: When charging, a balivarha deals double damage with its gore attack.
After damage, activate next turn until foe or balivarha dies. Gain pounce, fear immunity and 48 temporary HP.
